Messages.Author: bryan nelson
Messages.Body:
Victoria, a Malkavian from Dark Sovereigns. Her text reads: If victoria
is ready during your master phase, you may forfeit the edge to gain 2
pool. Can I forfeit the edge after I've already taken the 1 pool for
having the edge, thus gaining 3 pool total? Or does the forfeiting
happen before you would normally gain a pool for having the edge at the
start of your turn? Thanks

Messages.Author: Martin Jamieson
Messages.Body:


Yes. Pool gained from the edge is taken during the untap phase (the
first thing that always happens), the master phase is next and this is
where you give up the edge for a further 2 pool.

Martin.
